title: Iteration claim
description: Written by `arh claim` when an iteration number is taken. The directory creation is the lock; this file records who holds it.

agent.description: Harness that executed the claim, detected from the environment.

agent_source.description: What determined `agent`: ARH_AGENT, a harness environment marker, or USER. Markers can be inherited from an outer session.

declared_agent.description: Agent name the operator declared, which may differ from the detected one.

inferred_agent.description: Agent the session itself reported, kept when the configured producer outranks it.

inferred_from.description: Where `inferred_agent` came from: ARH_AGENT, a harness environment marker, or USER.

title.description: The question, stated as a question.

harness_config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of .arh/config/harnesses.md at claim time, so a change to the review terms during the iteration is visible. Empty when the file did not exist.

knowledge_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the durable-knowledge files at claim time (DIRECTIVES.md, GOTCHAS.md, and site_gotchas when site.md names one), keyed by file. Files that did not exist are absent.

freeze_journal.description: True when the iteration was claimed under the freeze journal (.arh/freezes.tsv): its freeze must have a journal row, and arh migrate never backfills one for it.
